knowledge.purpose: Increment/decrement counter for bounded numeric entry (integer or decimal via step) with minus and plus controls; submits a number
useCases: Item quantity on a cart line or order form
antiPatterns: Wide or unbounded range — stepping one unit at a time is too slow; take a typed number in form.input
Choice from labelled options — use form.segmented-control
Unlabelled stepper — the label is the field's name; there is no fallback
knowledge.implementation:
Further use cases:
- Compact quantity picker inside a card

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label; also names the field for screen readers. Give it — there is no fallback text.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment of the +/- buttons and the field step, e.g. 0.5 or 0.01 for money. "any" accepts every decimal (buttons then move by 1).

jsonSchema.description: Surface state key the value is written to on change, so {{state.<key>}} reads it — a summary step of a multi-step form, or a list filter. Mirrors form.select and form.segmented-control.

props.name: decreaseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the minus button, in the app's language.

props.name: increaseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the plus button, in the app's language.
